claim_boundary: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION fixed-speed, one-lane tap playback with retained fly weights; no within-map learning, other lanes or holds
engineering_assumption: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION: one fixed neural simulator and synaptic vector persist across the map; the existing nontrainable position-bin readout is rearmed only on blank-to-visible transitions. There are no overlapping cues. The policy receives current visible position or blank, no note ID/time/score.
limitations: Three separated taps only. This is continuous neural playback, not training inside a map, four-key play, chords, holds or live osu!lazer.
primary_gate: Learned arm: exactly three first DOWNs, one per note, all within ±73500us; exactly three UPs, no extras; all three headless tap judgements Good-or-better; one neural initialization and three readout rearms; exact two-run replay. Control: no DOWN and three MISS. Weight vector immutable throughout playback. Feedback labels delivered only when available.
weight_selection: Use the first completed seed in the predeclared fixed-speed list (907), before observing this three-note map. Keep its final retained weights fixed. Matched initial weights from the same receipt are the no-learning control.
